messages.subject: Project Relay - Mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Good to reconnect on this one. Bracken is looking at the acquisition of the entire share capital of Helix Logistics and would like to open diligence shortly, so enclosing our standard mutual NDA for your side.

Key points: it is mutual, runs for a two-year term (clause 12), and carries a 12-month standstill on Bracken (clause 9) and a reciprocal 12-month non-solicitation of senior employees (clause 10). It is a clean confidentiality form - no residual-knowledge carve-out in this one.

Grateful for any comments; otherwise happy to get it signed this week so the data room can open.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Elena, Sarah,

Forwarding Hargrove's reply for the file. One thing worth flagging: Rachel has taken our NDA clean with no residuals point. On Lumen last year she dug in hard on a residual-knowledge carve-out and would not move off it. Same firm, same partner, opposite position here. Not a problem for us - we prefer it without - but flagging it as a counterparty-consistency point in case it matters when we look across her deals.

Tom
